title: Macro phone study-app tour, scan to quiz
summary: A dark phone UI shot in shallow-focus macro on tilted planes: home, new topic, scan pages, a topic card counting up, step trail, reading screen, mascot and a quiz answered. Black tagline and wordmark close.
use_when: A mobile app with a clear multi-step flow (create, capture, learn, test) to walk through in 30 s
Dark product UI that looks premium when lit like a physical object in macro
An app with a mascot or character that can carry an emotional beat mid-film
Store launch where the close is mark, wordmark and store badges

look.type_style: UI: geometric sans, sentence case, normal tracking, list titles ~5 % H when in macro; close: bold geometric sans wordmark ~4 % H and a small regular tagline ~2 % H, both white on pure black

sfx.event: topic card lands into the list (row 7)

structure.shot: dark phone screen in macro, leaned back: small gear icon, wordmark, greeting line with user name, tiny sub-line; red clock pill at the top edge
structure.camera: push-in ~1.00 to 1.15 over 38 fr with slow upward drift (motion.json zoom ~15 %/s); shallow focus, far edge blurred
structure.motion: no element motion; camera only, easings.inOutSine (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: search field and a large outlined new-topic button, a finished topic card with a full green progress bar below
structure.camera: dolly across the tilted plane down to the button, plane rotates ~10 deg (motion.json rot 10 deg/s at 2 s); focus racks from button to blur
structure.motion: camera move easings.inOutSine ~37 fr (±0.25 s); content static

structure.shot: new-topic form screen: title, name field, page-slot card with a plus; then a bottom sheet with two options (take photo, pick from gallery)
structure.camera: fast swing at 2.50 from a steep diagonal tilt to a flatter top-down tilt, settles by 2.77; slow push to the sheet at 4.50
structure.motion: swing springs.cameraIn ~8 fr (overshoot not measurable); bottom sheet rises at 4.27 to 4.50, springs.ui ~7 fr (±0.25 s); option rows stagger ~1 cell (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: whole phone on a dark blue backdrop showing a camera viewfinder on a textbook page; a stack of three paper pages slides out to the right of the phone and floats
structure.camera: pull-out to the full device at 5.27, then near static, drift ~2 %/s
structure.motion: pages slide out from behind the phone 5.50 to 5.77, springs.heavy ~10 fr (±0.25 s), fan offset ~3 % W per page; pages bright and slightly glowing

structure.shot: list of topic cards with segmented green progress bars and percentages scrolling up into the home header and the new-topic button
structure.camera: tilt-plane, push-in ~1 %/s while the list scrolls up; deep focus falloff on the lower rows
structure.motion: list scroll ~1 card per 0.25 s, easings.outQuint ~30 fr (±0.25 s); a new processing card appears at the top of the list at 8.00

structure.shot: single topic card floating alone on a dark blue backdrop with a processing sub-line, then the card switches to a zero-progress count
structure.camera: card drifts from upper right to lower left then back to upper left; at ~11.5 the plane rotates ~5 deg toward camera
structure.motion: card enters at 9.77 from off-frame left, springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s); content swaps at 12.00 (processing to 0 of N, 0 %) as a cut-free state change

structure.shot: the phone rises behind the floating card; the card lands into its slot at the top of the home list, full phone visible small in frame
structure.camera: pull-out ~1.10 to 1.00 across 30 fr, plane tilts slightly back
structure.motion: card drops into list springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s); phone rises from below springs.heavy ~15 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: dark plane with numbered step circles counting down from the low teens to two, a long rail of dots crossing the frame
structure.camera: dolly along a tilted path of circles at high speed (motion.json pan ~740 px/s at 15 s), circles pass the lens in macro with heavy depth blur
structure.motion: camera move easings.linear, one circle per ~0.25 s (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: lesson card with a small mascot head, card title and a filled blue start button above the current step circle
structure.camera: push-in ~1.00 to 1.08 on the card, then at 18.27 to 18.50 a fast zoom into the button label until it fills the frame
structure.motion: card held; final zoom easings.inExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: whole phone small on a dark blue backdrop, seen almost edge-on, turning to face camera; reading screen with a long body paragraph
structure.camera: orbit: phone yaw from ~70 deg to ~20 deg over 56 fr, push-in from a small device to ~45 % H
structure.motion: turn springs.heavy ~30 fr (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: macro on the reading screen: heading, a small AI tag, the paragraph lines
structure.camera: dolly down the paragraph on a tilted plane, ~1 line per 2 fr; focus racks along the lines
structure.motion: camera easings.inOutSine 30 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: large blue start-quiz button at the bottom of the screen; a hand pointer enters and presses it
structure.camera: camera settles onto the button 21.50 to 22.00, then pulls out to ~0.7 by 22.50
structure.motion: pointer enters from bottom right 22.00, press at ~22.40, springs.click squash (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: mascot character sitting on a dark plane under the wordmark and a question header bar
structure.camera: slow push-in
structure.motion: mascot changes expression at ~23.00 (frame swap); otherwise static

structure.shot: mascot close-up, a soft white light sweeps across its body
structure.camera: push-in ~1.00 to 1.30 over 33 fr
structure.motion: light spot travels left to right, easings.inOutSine ~30 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: question card in macro, three-line question text crossing the frame; a bright lens flare passes over the words
structure.camera: dolly right to left along the line of text on a tilted plane; slight push
structure.motion: flare sweeps ~20 % W per 0.25 s, easings.linear (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: mascot above, then four lettered answer options on the tilted phone screen
structure.camera: fast tilt down from the mascot to the options at 25.50 to 25.77 (motion.json pan ~280 px/s, zoom -50 %/s)
structure.motion: camera springs.cameraOut ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: macro on the four answer rows; the third option turns green with a small confetti burst, rows dim
structure.camera: pull-out from extreme macro ~2.0 to ~1.0 over 23 fr (26.27 to 27.00), then hold with drift
structure.motion: selection at ~27.77: row fills green, confetti burst ~8 fr (±0.25 s); fade to black 28.27 to 28.50

structure.shot: pure black hold, then one small centred tagline, one sentence of 7 words about the future of learning
structure.camera: static
structure.motion: black 37 fr; tagline fades in at ~29.75, 8 fr (±0.25 s); holds 45 fr

structure.shot: bold wordmark centred on black; a tiny credit line fades in at the top
structure.camera: static
structure.motion: tagline swaps to wordmark at 31.27 (one-cell change, no visible animation at 4 fps); credit line fade ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: app icon with the mascot appears above the wordmark, two store badges stack below
structure.camera: static
structure.motion: icon and first badge appear at 32.77, second badge at 33.00; fade ~6 fr (±0.25 s), stagger ~7 fr (±0.25 s)

params.brand: brand.json: dark bg, fg, one blue accent for primary buttons, green for progress
params.content.screens: 6-8 app screens rebuilt as React UI: home, new item form, capture sheet, list with progress, lesson card, reading screen, question, answers
params.content.mascot: optional character image used on the lesson card, mid-film close-up and the app icon
params.content.badges: store badges to show at the end (0-2)
params.timing.bpm: music tempo (reference ~133 BPM); cuts are not on the beat

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s) and motion.json; springs, staggers and fr counts below 8 fr are defaults, not measured. One-shot camera travel inside shots 1, 2, 3 and 5: transitions between their rows are continuous; real cuts only at 7.27, 18.63, 26.27, soft dissolve 23.17-23.60. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is music only, no VO). cut_on_beat 0/3. Not in vocabulary (see recipe.md Proposed terms): page-pullout (paper pages slide out of the phone), step-trail (numbered circles on a tilted rail passed at speed), lens-flare sweep over UI. The whole film is shallow focus: only a band of ~20 % H is sharp in macro rows.
